alt_text: A pale, round, porous sponge on a thin white stalk grows from a dark, rocky ocean floor.

caption.rendered: During Dive 07 of the 2026 American Samoa ROV + Mapping Exploration expedition, we observed this large Caulophacus sp. sponge at a depth of 1,378 meters (4,521 feet). Image courtesy of NOAA Ocean Exploration, 2026 American Samoa ROV + Mapping Exploration.
